column6: The first Community season opens on December 1. Submit your ideas in December, vote on them in January, and in February the top 16 go head to head in a bracket. The winner gets built into APD, with its own status page so you can follow it from planned to released. You need a Google account and must be 16 or older to take part. The game itself is open to everyone.

column5: APD is in closed testing on Google Play
column6: APD is now in a closed test on Google Play, with a new build every eight hours. The full source of every build is published alongside it, linked from About. Recent builds added stair walking that keeps going unless something actually threatens you, a What happened screen when you die, and a lot of UIMSD fixes. Public release is planned for January 1, 2027.

Metamorphosis now lets you choose the matching talent position from each of the other five classes. Tap a talent to inspect it before choosing. Your invested points transfer; already-owned talents remain unavailable.

The Community preview is now available in private testing. Explore how player submissions, discussions, qualification voting and elimination tournaments are planned to shape APD. Online participation is not available yet.
APD is in private testing. UIMSD provides local run statistics, filtering, sorting and reports. The game is still in development, and player feedback will help identify problems before wider testing.
